However, no cited evidence addresses Si-containing alloys, Si diffusion rates, or SiO2 formation, leaving the Si premise unsupported. Al and Si form continuous, coherent, slow-growing protective oxides (Al2O3, SiO2)
Al and Si have lower diffusion rates and higher thermodynamic oxide stability than Mn
The oxide scale morphology (continuous vs. porous) directly controls oxygen ingress and spallation
